result:
I updated `src/exports/links.ts` so download links now expire. I haven't run or type-checked it.

- **Type:** `DownloadLink` has a new `expiresAt: string` field.
- **Expiry:** `createDownloadLink` sets it to 7 days after creation, as an ISO timestamp.
- **URL:** the URL now ends in `?token=…&expires=<expiresAt>`, with the timestamp URL-encoded.

This change only puts the expiry in the link. Nothing here rejects an expired link, so whatever serves the download has to check `expires`. I didn't look for that code.
